description: Return the full append-only transparency-log history for a task and cryptographically verify the hash chain covering it. If `intact` is false, `broken_at_seq` points to the first altered or missing row. Deletion of a task produces a `task.deleted` event with the final row's sha256 — history survives deletion.

include_events.description: If true (default), include the full ordered event list in the response.

task_id.description: Task id, or a pasted Tango task URL.

name: verify_task_history
title: Verify a task's tamper-evident history
